summary: Frontend adds an editable content provider that differentiates local draft vs backend published content, plus Edit Mode UI actions for “Publish changes” and “Reload published version” with English status/toasts. Backend changes show a new ValentineContent type and an in-memory publishedContent value, but the diff summary does not provide clear evidence of the required query/update publish API, stable persistence, or strict admin-only publish enforcement.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend persistence for published ValentineContent with (1) a query method to fetch currently published content, (2) an update method to overwrite/publish content restricted to authorized admin, and (3) stable storage across upgrades.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows a `publishedContent : ValentineContent` variable and type definitions, but does not show any `getPublishedContent` query method, any `updatePublishedContent` update method, any stable variable usage for persistence across upgrades, or explicit admin allowlist enforcement for publishing.
